item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=path+dependence+active+learning+preference+formation+reinforcement+learning&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"Scarcity-Coefficient Gated Projection Reinforcement Learning for Planning-Layer Capacity Activation in Emergency Wireless Networks.\", \"abstract\": \"After infrastructure disruption, an emergency wireless controller must meet urgent communication demand and preserve resources for later periods. We propose Scarcity-Coefficient Gated Projection Reinforcement Learning (SCGP-RL). It jointly selects total planning-layer activation and a regional capacity upper-bound vector. Scarcity and urgent-demand evidence shape the activation intent. Scalar and capped-simplex projections enforce the coupled action constraints. A planning capacity unit (PCU) is defined as a calibratable service-capacity quantum. In the common constrained evaluation, SCGP-RL reduced the unmet urgent-demand score from 0.6643 for Projected CPO to 0.4919. It also satisfied all the executed hard constraints. Component tests show that the urgent-demand gate drives rapid service response and that the marginal demand-relief estimate provides a smaller benefit.
